name: ctm-tag
description: Lightweight call annotation tool that injects into Call Tracking Metrics (CTM) and lets your team tag calls with shared, real-time notes.

scripts.package: npm run build && rm -f ctm-tag-extension.zip && cd dist && zip -qr ../ctm-tag-extension.zip . && cd .. && echo "\nPackaged → ctm-tag-extension.zip  (share this file with teammates)"
